proposals.title: REPORT ON REDUCING CHEMICAL FOOTPRINT
proposals.proponent: Trillium Asset Management, LLC, on behalf of Trillium P21 Global Equity Fund; First Affirmative Financial Network, LLC, on behalf of Mark Demanes and Allen Hancock
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report, at reasonable cost and omitting proprietary information, describing if and how TJX plans to reduce its chemical footprint.
proposals.evidence: your Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: REPORT ON ANIMAL WELFARE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent analysis of material risks of operating without a company-wide animal welfare policy or restrictions on animal-sourced products associated with cruelty.
proposals.evidence: your Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: SETTING TARGET AMOUNTS FOR CEO COMPENSATION
proposals.proponent: Trillium Asset Management, LLC, on behalf of Kay Berkson and the Benedictine Sisters of Mount St. Scholastica
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the compensation committee consider pay grades and salary ranges of all employee classifications when setting CEO target pay and describe compliance in proxy statements.

proposals.title: DISCLOSURE REGARDING EXECUTIVE SHARE RETENTION
proposals.proponent: New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Urges the compensation committee to disclose whether it requires executives to retain a significant percentage of equity-acquired shares until normal retirement age.
